title: Heaps & Top-K

views.title: Heaps & Top-K
views.intro: For K largest keep a MIN-heap of size K; for K smallest keep a MAX-heap. Two heaps track a median. K-way merge pushes the next element of whichever list just emitted. Greedy scheduling problems often pair a sort with a heap.
table: Merge sorted lists, kth in sorted matrix, smallest range

files.desc: Kth largest (heap + quickselect), K closest, top words, median finder, K-way merge, task scheduler, reorganize string, meeting rooms, IPO, furthest building, ugly numbers

pitfalls: Heap of size K for K largest is a MIN-heap; people reach for a max-heap by reflex.
PriorityQueue has no decrease-key: push duplicates and skip stale entries on pop.
Comparator subtraction can overflow; use Integer.compare for large values.

views.title: Heaps: Hard Variants
views.intro: The senior-level heap problems add one twist to the basic Top-K: a ratio sort first, removal from the middle, a decrease-key, or a boundary that expands from its lowest point. Learn to spot which twist it is.
table: Pick k items minimizing a ratio-weighted cost
Median or order statistic of a sliding window (needs removal)
3D flooding: always expand from the lowest wall
Schedule maximum tasks, evict the longest

files.desc: Sliding window median (two TreeSets), min cost to hire workers, max performance, k smallest pairs, kth smallest prime fraction, course schedule III, connect sticks, trapping rain water II, single-threaded CPU, minimum deviation, KthLargest stream, indexed min-PQ with decrease-key

pitfalls: A PriorityQueue cannot remove from the middle in O(log n); use TreeSet of (value, index) pairs when a window slides.
Ratio problems: sort by the ratio first, then the heap holds the quantity you want to drop.
Duplicate values in a TreeSet collapse; key by index, or by (value, index).

decisions.a: Two heaps (max-heap lower half, min-heap upper half)
Sort by start + min-heap of end times

decisions.q: Rearrange so equal items are not adjacent?
decisions.a: Max-heap by count, hold back the previous item

decisions.q: Repeatedly pick the best available option as capacity grows?
decisions.a: Sort by unlock key + max-heap of rewards
Two ordered sets of indices (removal is required)

decisions.q: Choose k workers, minimize cost when pay depends on a ratio?
decisions.a: Sort by wage/quality, keep a max-heap of qualities
Sort by deadline, max-heap of durations, evict the longest

decisions.q: 3D water level or flooding from the edges?
decisions.a: Min-heap on the boundary, expand from the lowest wall

decisions.q: Smallest k pairs from two sorted arrays?
decisions.a: Seed (i, 0), push (i, j + 1) after each pop
